courses.title: Private Shamanic Healing Session
courses.description: A 90-minute session with Kathleen Duggan, offered online worldwide, that opens with a consultation and works with her helping spirits through practices such as soul retrieval, power-animal retrieval, ancestral healing and extraction. It ends with guidance on integrating the session and on self-care.

left_out: Shamanic Healing Session for Children: the page says anxiety, headaches and depression can potentially be healed and carries testimonials about children with autism improving (treatment claims for children).
flags: Private Shamanic Healing Session: among 'common reasons people give' the page lists healing trauma and 'chronic pain that doctors can't diagnose'. That names a condition without a cure claim and does not advise against medical care, so the item is kept under the 12 Nov rule; owner may judge.
Offerings on this listing would be 8 of 10.
